from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689809/attempts/82cd395e7c604aefb1723d109802e08f/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    hr = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    vc = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    rb = [-1] + hr + [h]
    cb = [-1] + vc + [w]
    rowspans = [(rb[i]+1, rb[i+1]) for i in range(len(rb)-1)]
    colspans = [(cb[i]+1, cb[i+1]) for i in range(len(cb)-1)]
    sr0, sr1 = rowspans[0]
    sc0, sc1 = colspans[-1]
    source = [row[sc0:sc1] for row in grid[sr0:sr1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0,r1 in rowspans:
        for c0,c1 in colspans:
            for r in range(r0,r1):
                for c in range(c0,c1):
                    out[r][c] = source[r-r0][c-c0]
    return out
'''
p=base/'task-23fc5d93.py'; p.write_text(code)
